answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can make each identity post a 150-token bond locked for 21 days and pass two rotating audits before it earns any voting weight. Every additional linked identity raises the required bond by 30% and adds an extra audit round, so a farm's marginal cost climbs faster than its output. Peers verify signed task receipts against the ledger and slash the bond on mismatch. A violet tag marks audited accounts, each approved answer leaves an echo in the public log, and a lotus-tier reviewer pool rotates so no single operator can approve its own clones.
